mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtCreditDeptPopList */ SELECT X.IRS_NO AS IRS_NO , X.BUYER AS COM_CODE , X.COM_NAME_LOC AS COM_NAME , X.PO_NO AS PO_NO , X.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ , F_GET_PO_STTS(X.BUYER, X.PO_NO, X.PO_SEQ, 1) AS STATUS , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , X.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , X.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , X.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY , X.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY , X.DO_QTY AS DO_QTY , X.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , X.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , X.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK , X.KEP_DEPT AS DEPT_CODE , ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = X.KEP_DEPT ) AS DEPT_NAME , X.ITEM_AMT AS PO_AMT , X.NO_AR_AMT AS UN_GR_AMT , X.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE , X.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE FROM ( SELECT MAX(U.IRS_NO) AS IRS_NO , U.BUYER , U.PO_NO , U.PO_SEQ , MAX(U.COM_NAME_LOC) AS COM_NAME_LOC , MAX(U.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , MAX(U.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION , MAX(U.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION , MAX(U.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY , MAX(U.GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY , MAX(U.DO_QTY) AS DO_QTY , MAX(U.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(U.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , MAX(U.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK , MAX(( SELECT MBM.KEP_DEPT FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MBM WHERE MBM.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MBM.BUYER = U.BUYER AND MBM.STATUS = 'C' AND MBM.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) ) AS KEP_DEPT , SUM(U.NO_AR_AMT) AS NO_AR_AMT , MAX(U.ITEM_AMT) AS ITEM_AMT , MAX(ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE , MAX(RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE FROM ( SELECT CMPY.IRS_NO , PODT.BUYER , PODT.PO_NO , PODT.PO_SEQ , PODT.ITEM_AMT , CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , PODT.DESCRIPTION , PODT.SPECIFICATION , PODT.ITEM_QTY , PODT.GR_QTY , PODT.DO_QTY , PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO , PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , PODT.PO_REMARK , PODT.ADD_DATE , PODT.RD_DATE , CASE WHEN GRDT.BUYER IS NULL THEN PODT.ITEM_AMT WHEN GRDT.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE GRDT.ITEM_AMT END AS NO_AR_AMT , MBM.KEP_DEPT FROM ICOMPODT PODT , ICOMGRDT GRDT , ICOMCMPY CMPY , MIS_BUYER_MNG MBM WHERE PODT.ADD_DATE >= '20140101' AND CMPY.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND CMPY.BUSINESS_COND = 'B' AND CMPY.COM_CODE = PODT.BUYER AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = GRDT.BUYER(+) AND PODT.PO_NO = GRDT.PO_NO(+) AND PODT.PO_SEQ = GRDT.PO_SEQ(+) AND GRDT.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND MBM.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND CMPY.COM_CODE = MBM.BUYER AND MBM.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MBM.STATUS = 'C' AND MBM.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND CMPY.IRS_NO = #{st_irs_no} AND MBM.KEP_DEPT = #{st_kep_dept} AND PODT.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_strt_date} AND #{st_end_date} AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%' ) U GROUP BY U.BUYER, U.PO_NO, U.PO_SEQ HAVING SUM(U.NO_AR_AMT) <> 0 ) X WHERE X.BUYER NOT IN ( SELECT COD.CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'DW05' UNION ALL SELECT 'KRKORE0254' FROM DUAL ) ORDER BY IRS_NO, ADD_DATE
